contracts: Currency fingerprints use the exact signed scaled Int64 without abs, float conversion or rounding. Decimal fingerprints use a temporary signed coefficient/scale view that strips fractional trailing zeros, mapping all zero scales to (0,0). Retained values, scales, declarations and policies are never normalized or replaced.

Only known uniform Currency/Decimal columns with ordinary NULL qualify. Active paired metadata, depth-zero available-field proof and all-tuple admission stay unchanged; no first-row inference or mixed fixed-family profile is introduced.

Existing retained vectors and SQL key comparisons stay authoritative. Hash collisions use the original comparator; unexpected actual buffered cells disable the entire directory and expose every retained representative to fallback for this and later rows without budget refund.

Current progressive required-profile validation, first encounter group keys, complete global numeric/NULL policy cohorts, syntactic aggregate states, HAVING deferred-projection suppression and checked EOF remain intact.

Every Decimal normalization iteration consumes shared work and checks cancellation. Existing paid lazy directory allocation, probe/rehash/copy accounting and independent native/query/output limits stay in force. Canonicalization allocates no per-value buffer.

UNION promotion and each distinct prefix retain their written policy/operator stages. Later UNION ALL duplicates stay present; there is no retroactive final-cohort replay or altered scalar comparison/coercion.
independent_controls: Existing BigInt cross-product models check exact fractions independently of production normalization, including all scales0..28, signs, zero, 96-bit boundaries, Currency signed minimum and adjacent values beyond binary64 integral precision.

Buffered GROUP/DISTINCT/UNION and progressive grouped/HAVING controls preserve first retained Decimal coefficient/scale, nullable tuples, alias consumers and crossed prepare/execute profiles. Forced collisions and mixed actual fixed carriers exercise authoritative comparison and whole-operation fallback.

Conservative NULL-key lineage, late String extrema policy completion, actual String conflicts, eager operands, EOF failures, swallowed callback rejection, original sink identity, cumulative quotas, every observed cancellation checkpoint and prepared reuse are pinned independently.

12,000 descending unique Currency and Decimal populations complete GROUP and DISTINCT under an explicit five-million-step allowance in both arithmetic profiles; this is a bounded-work admission check, not a timing/optimizer claim.

Existing integral/Boolean directory, raw/Error fallback, numeric relational keys, progressive pipeline/HAVING, crosstab/named/alias/grouped and UNION policy regressions pass alongside the new profile.
